note: These are possible stages, not universally mandatory sequences. Unknown families stay usable without a forced template.

diagnostic_testing.label: Diagnostic testing
diagnostic_testing.notes: An available result does not establish review or communication. Collection time is not review time.

document_follow_up.label: Document follow-up
document_follow_up.notes: A sent letter is source status, not closure of embedded instructions.

appointment_coordination.label: Appointment coordination
appointment_coordination.notes: A booking does not prove access, transport, or patient confirmation. Preferences are constraints, not orders.

communication.label: Communication
communication.notes: Delivery of a reminder is not completion of the requested downstream action. A queued telephone script is not a transcript.

external_document.label: Obtaining an external document
external_document.notes: Requesting a note is not receiving it or completing reconciliation.

unknown.label: Unclassified task
unknown.notes: Unknown families remain usable. Do not force them into an unsuitable template.
